description: We are building a compelling narrative-driven project titled "Abandoned but not Forgotten" focusing on NASA's legendary Mars Exploration Rover, Opportunity (Oppy). Our goal is to bring out the emotional legacy and scientific impact of humanity's most resilient robot through a creative visual storytelling format. We combine space exploration passion with hardware-driven historical insights to inspire the world!
summary: For the NASA Space Apps Challenge (Abandoned but not Forgotten), our team Ysrissa presents an in-depth storytelling and technical documentation project dedicated to NASA's legendary twin Mars Exploration Rovers — Spirit (MER-A) and Opportunity (MER-B). Initially designed for a modest 90-day mission in 2004, these robotic pioneers defied every extreme environmental condition on the Red Planet, operating for over a decade. They uncovered definitive geological evidence of ancient liquid water, discovered iron-oxide "blueberries" in Meridiani Planum, and paved the way for modern astrobiology. Our project highlights their incredible engineering resilience, major scientific milestones, and their enduring legacy in our quest to understand Mars and our place in the cosmos. Through this detailed 7-page presentation, we honor these silent robotic geologists left behind on the Martian surface—ensuring they are abandoned, but never forgotten.
details: NASA public archives, Mars Exploration Rover (MER) mission logs, historical mission data, and open-access planetary science records regarding Spirit (MER-A) and Opportunity (MER-B).
